# Ironclad Commercial Floors - Vancouver Commercial Flooring Contractor

> Ironclad Commercial Floors is Greater Vancouver's premier commercial and industrial flooring contractor. Headquartered at 783 E 60th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5X 2A5, we provide 24/7 heavy-duty concrete polishing, high-solids epoxy coatings, commercial carpet tiles, luxury vinyl planks (LVP), and medical-grade sheet vinyl systems across the Lower Mainland.

## Organization & Authority
- **Company Name**: IRONCLAD COMMERCIAL FLOORS
- **Business Type**: Commercial Flooring Contractor / Industrial Flooring Specialist
- **Physical Address**: 783 E 60th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5X 2A5 Canada
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 49.2158341, Longitude -123.088378
- **Phone**: (604) 540-3999
- **Email**: info@ironcladcommercialfloors.ca
- **Website**: https://ironcladcommercialfloors.ca
- **Hours**: Open 24/7 (Emergency Dispatch & Scheduled Overnight / Weekend Installation)
- **Safety & Licensing**: COR Safety Certified, $5M Commercial General Liability & WCB Insured, Red Seal Journeyman Floorcovering Installers, ICRI Certified Concrete Substrate Technicians.

## Primary Capabilities & Services
- **Polished Concrete Systems**: Industrial planetary diamond grinding from 30-grit to 3000-grit high gloss with lithium silicate densifiers (Husqvarna & HTC fleet).
- **Epoxy & Polyaspartic Coatings**: 100% solids industrial epoxy, metallic decorative epoxy, urethane mortar cementitious toppings, thermal shock coatings for food processing, and chemical-resistant secondary containment.
- **Commercial Carpet & Modular Tiles**: High-traffic solution-dyed nylon tiles from Shaw Contract and Interface with moisture-barrier backing and sound-dampening acoustic absorption.
- **Resilient & Sheet Vinyl**: Commercial luxury vinyl tile/plank (LVT/LVP) with 20mil–30mil wear layers, seamless medical-grade sheet vinyl with heat-welded seams and 6-inch integral flash coving for sterile hospitals and laboratories.
- **Subfloor Preparation & Moisture Mitigation**: Laser-guided self-leveling cementitious underlayments, ASTM F2170 in-situ relative humidity moisture testing, shot blasting, and epoxy vapor barriers up to 100% RH.
- **24/7 Zero-Downtime Installation**: Fast-curing polyaspartics and overnight modular replacement so facilities remain 100% operational during business hours.
